notes.title: Repeat Demo november update
notes.content:
[h2]Hello![/h2]
We have been working hard on Repeat in the past few months and there are results that we would [b]love to show you![/b] 
Most of the changes happened under the hood, and on the whole game itself (coming soon!) but we wanted to show you where we are heading and what you can expect on release. And we believe the best way is for you to [b]play it[/b]: so we have updated the demo so it meets our new standard! We believe that in doing so we also managed to adress most (if not all) the issues you guys have raised in your messages. Thanks for those!

[h2]So whats new?[/h2]
The Repeat Box speaks! Giving you all the information you need.

The Bubble Suit inflates! Giving you more freedom to move and bounce around the space.

The Demo level is better in every aspect: graphics, possibilities, understandability.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40636825/1134db855b3a8027637e310e7384409a00ebebad.gif[/img]

[h2]What should you do?[/h2]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1567100/Repeat/]Play it of course![/url] As always, we would love to hear you feedback. We believe that you will enjoy it even more that the last one. 

- Team Repeat
